## Narration templates

Path explanations are composed from these. No model is involved.

- `acted_in` — {subject} appeared in {object}
- `aired_on` — {subject} aired on {object}
- `based_on` — {subject} is based on {object}
- `belongs_to_genre` — {subject} is a {object} film
- `broader_than` — {subject} is a broader concept than {object}
- `composed_for` — {subject} composed the score for {object}
- `directed` — {subject} directed {object}
- `distributed_by` — {subject} was distributed by {object}
- `episode_of` — {subject} is an episode of {object}
- `explores_theme` — {subject} explores {object}
- `features_character` — {subject} features the character {object}
- `influenced_by` — {subject} was influenced by {object}
- `part_of_franchise` — {subject} is part of {object}
- `portrayed_by` — {subject} is portrayed by {object}
- `produced_by` — {subject} was produced by {object}
- `remake_of` — {subject} is a remake of {object}
- `season_of` — {subject} is a season of {object}
- `sequel_to` — {subject} is a sequel to {object}
- `shot` — {subject} was the cinematographer on {object}
- `similar_to` — {subject} is similar to {object}
- `wrote` — {subject} wrote {object}
